source.basis: The paper defines eta=[x,y,psi], nu=[u,v,r], tau=[Fx,Fy,tau_psi], and the conventional marine Jacobian. Dataset derivatives independently confirm the same signs.

wrench.application: net generalized body wrench about the model body-frame origin

time.schedule: source timestamps; interval input is zero-order held from the previous sample

data_consistency_validation.method: central numerical derivative compared with xdot=cos(psi)u-sin(psi)v, ydot=sin(psi)u+cos(psi)v, psidot=r; first/last two samples excluded

limitations: The source has no measured heave, roll, or pitch channels.
The source wrench is treated as a net generalized wrench; individual aerial-thruster locations are not replayed.
Mapping source x/y to N/E is a naming normalization; comparisons are invariant to the geodetic orientation of the experiment origin.
